description: This file defines the GrainCollectionOptions class, which contains configuration settings for idle grain collection in Orleans, including collection timing, timeouts, and memory pressure handling.

classes.name: GrainCollectionOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for grain collection, including collection timing, timeouts, and memory pressure settings.

methods.name: CollectionQuantum
methods.description: Property for regulating the periodic collection of inactive grains.

methods.name: DEFAULT_COLLECTION_QUANTUM
methods.description: Default TimeSpan value for CollectionQuantum, set to 1 minute.

methods.name: CollectionAge
methods.description: Property for the default period of inactivity before a grain is eligible for collection and deactivation.

methods.name: ClassSpecificCollectionAge
methods.description: Dictionary mapping grain types to specific collection ages.

methods.name: DEFAULT_ACTIVATION_TIMEOUT
methods.description: Default TimeSpan value for ActivationTimeout, set to 30 seconds.

methods.name: DEFAULT_DEACTIVATION_TIMEOUT
methods.description: Default TimeSpan value for DeactivationTimeout, set to 30 seconds.

methods.name: EnableActivationSheddingOnMemoryPressure
methods.description: Flag indicating if memory pressure should trigger grain activation shedding.

methods.name: MemoryUsagePollingPeriod
methods.description: Interval at which memory usage is polled.

methods.name: MemoryUsageLimitPercentage
methods.description: Memory usage percentage at which grain collection is triggered.

methods.name: MemoryUsageTargetPercentage
methods.description: Target memory usage percentage after grain collection.
